summary: FINAL VIEWINGS 15TH AUGUST Well-presented three-bedroom home in a sought-after location. Spacious accommodation including a lounge/dining room and modern kitchen, and three good-sized bedrooms. Benefiting from excellent transport links to Carlisle city centre, the M6, and A69, plus a private front aspect, enclosed rear yard, and attractive low-maintenance garden.
description:
A 3 bedroom property, located in a popular residential area, south, east of the city. Excellent road links are nearby allowing easy access to and from the centre of Carlisle, M6 north and south and the A69 making this property a commuters dream.

The property is modern, tastefully decorated in neutral tones throughout and is beautifully presented inside and out. The front of the property is not overlooked by neighbouring properties so delivers a great feeling of privacy.

The property consists of entrance hall, lounge/dining area, kitchen, utility, 3 good sized bedrooms and shower room.

Externally there is an enclosed rear yard with an outbuilding and to the front there is garden made up of path, decking and shillies with some planted shrubs and bushes.

Directions From Carlisle city centre head east on Warwick Road turning right onto Eastern Way at the traffic lights. Just after the fire station turn left and then first left into Harraby. Follow this road to reach the T junction on to Edgehill Road.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road.
